problem:
Evaluate the integral $$
\displaystyle \int_(C)\sin \left(\frac{πy}{4}\right)ds
$$ along the line segment from $(1, 0, 1)$ to $(2, 2, 3)$.
worked_solution:
Use $r(t)=\langle1+t,2t,1+2t\rangle$, $0\le t\le1$. Its speed is $3$, so

$$
\begin{aligned}
\int_C\sin\left(\frac{\pi y}4\right)\,ds
&=3\int_0^1\sin\left(\frac{\pi t}2\right)\,dt\\
&=-\frac6\pi\left[\cos\left(\frac{\pi t}2\right)\right]_0^1
=\frac6\pi.
\end{aligned}
$$
